notes.title: Disorder Free To Download
notes.notes: Disorder will be made free to download as soon as Steam is able to make the change. We hope you enjoy the game and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Level Pack "To Expand" Free To All Players!
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 is now live, and it includes:
[list]
[*]A free pack of 5 all-new levels, available once you've beaten the main story
[*]Bug fixes, performance updates, and additional controller support
[*]Weird new journal pages once you've beaten all 5 levels of "To Expand"
[/list]

Please let us know what you think of the new levels.  They're available through the photos in the menu room.  If you'd like to see more free level packs, please share the game and tell your friends about it!

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the update :)

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Free Level Pack Incoming!
notes.notes:
A big disorderly update is in the pipes, including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] "To Expand" - a series of five all-new wit-testing, finger-blistering levels to further challenge those that have beaten the game
[*] new insight and/or secrets unlockable in your journal?!
[*] bug fixes and performance improvements
[*] additional third-party controller support
[/list]

You'll be able to get your hands on all of this goodness very soon!
Keep your eyes peeled and fingers at the ready!

notes.title: Now available on Mac OSX!
notes.notes:
For those of you who like apples in their gaming experience... well, [i]Disorder[/i]'s checkpoints are still marbles.  But you can now play on your Apple computer!

[b][i]Disorder[/i] is now available for Mac OSX!  Thanks for your patience and support, and please feel free to spread the word to any of your Mac-using friends![/b]

The development team is continuing to provide bug fixes, additional gamepad support, and possible content updates.  Keep your apples peeled! (Eyes are too cliché)

notes.title: Official Release Date Set
notes.notes:
It's been a long road with many challenges... actually... dang. Over two years, at this point. But! [i]Disorder[/i] is now ready.  It is time.

Mark your calendars!  It is slated for release on January 13th.

And to get more insight into the game's development process, between now and release the development team will be posting "Dev Diaries" to [url=https://www.facebook.com/disordergame]our Facebook page[/url].  Be sure to like it and keep an eye out for those if you're interested in finding out more about the game and the team at Swagabyte!
